passages.text: Then Joshua assembled all the tribes of Israel at Shechem. He summoned the elders, leaders, judges, and officers of Israel, and they presented themselves before God.
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel.
Joshua gathered all the tribes of Israel.
He brought them to Shechem.
He called for the elders of Israel.
He called for the leaders of Israel.
He called for the judges of Israel.
He called for the officers of Israel.
All these leaders came together.
They stood before God.
passages.original: וַיֶּאֶסֹ֧ף יְהוֹשֻׁ֛עַ אֶת־ כָּל־ שִׁבְטֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל שְׁכֶ֑מָה וַיִּקְרָא֩ לְזִקְנֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל וּלְרָאשָׁ֗יו וּלְשֹֽׁפְטָיו֙ וּלְשֹׁ֣טְרָ֔יו וַיִּֽתְיַצְּב֖וּ לִפְנֵ֥י הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃

passages.text: And Joshua said to all the people, “This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘Long ago your fathers, including Terah the father of Abraham and Nahor, lived beyond the Euphrates and worshiped other gods.
passages.sermon:
Joshua spoke to all the people.
Joshua said, “This is what the LORD says.
The LORD is the God of Israel.
Long ago, your ancestors lived beyond the Euphrates River.
Terah was the father of Abraham and Nahor.
Your ancestors worshiped other gods.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁ֜עַ אֶל־ כָּל־ הָעָ֗ם כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָה֮ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ בְּעֵ֣בֶר הַנָּהָ֗ר יָשְׁב֤וּ אֲבֽוֹתֵיכֶם֙ מֵֽעוֹלָ֔ם תֶּ֛רַח אֲבִ֥י אַבְרָהָ֖ם וַאֲבִ֣י נָח֑וֹר וַיַּעַבְד֖וּ אֱלֹהִ֥ים אֲחֵרִֽים׃

passages.text: But I took your father Abraham from beyond the Euphrates and led him through all the land of Canaan, and I multiplied his descendants. I gave him Isaac, and to Isaac I gave Jacob and Esau. I gave Esau Mount Seir to possess, but Jacob and his sons went down to Egypt.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to the people of Israel.
God reminded them of their history.
God took Abraham, their ancestor, from beyond the Euphrates River.
God led Abraham through all the land of Canaan.
God made Abraham’s descendants many.
God gave Abraham a son named Isaac.
God gave Isaac two sons, Jacob and Esau.
God gave Esau the mountain called Seir to own.
Jacob and his sons went down to Egypt.
passages.original: וָ֠אֶקַּח אֶת־ אֲבִיכֶ֤ם אֶת־ אַבְרָהָם֙ מֵעֵ֣בֶר הַנָּהָ֔ר וָאוֹלֵ֥ךְ אוֹת֖וֹ בְּכָל־ אֶ֣רֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן וָאֶרֶב אֶת־ זַרְע֔וֹ וָֽאֶתֶּן־ ל֖וֹ אֶת־ יִצְחָֽק׃ וָאֶתֵּ֣ן לְיִצְחָ֔ק אֶֽת־ יַעֲקֹ֖ב וְאֶת־ עֵשָׂ֑ו וָאֶתֵּ֨ן לְעֵשָׂ֜ו אֶת־ הַ֤ר שֵׂעִיר֙ לָרֶ֣שֶׁת אוֹת֔וֹ וְיַעֲקֹ֥ב וּבָנָ֖יו יָרְד֥וּ מִצְרָֽיִם׃

passages.text: Then I sent Moses and Aaron, and I afflicted the Egyptians by what I did there, and afterward I brought you out.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD sent Moses.
The LORD sent Aaron.
The LORD punished the Egyptians.
The LORD did this by His actions among them.
After this, the LORD brought you out of Egypt.
passages.original: וָאֶשְׁלַ֞ח אֶת־ מֹשֶׁ֤ה וְאֶֽת־ אַהֲרֹן֙ וָאֶגֹּ֣ף אֶת־ מִצְרַ֔יִם כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשִׂ֖יתִי בְּקִרְבּ֑וֹ וְאַחַ֖ר הוֹצֵ֥אתִי אֶתְכֶֽם׃

passages.text: When I brought your fathers out of Egypt and you reached the Red Sea, the Egyptians pursued them with chariots and horsemen as far as the Red Sea.
passages.sermon:
God acted with power and purpose.
God brought your ancestors out of Egypt.
Your ancestors traveled until they reached the Red Sea.
The Egyptians chased your ancestors.
The Egyptians used chariots and horsemen.
The Egyptians pursued your ancestors all the way to the Red Sea.
passages.original: וָֽאוֹצִ֤יא אֶת־ אֲבֽוֹתֵיכֶם֙ מִמִּצְרַ֔יִם וַתָּבֹ֖אוּ הַיָּ֑מָּה וַיִּרְדְּפ֨וּ מִצְרַ֜יִם אַחֲרֵ֧י אֲבוֹתֵיכֶ֛ם בְּרֶ֥כֶב וּבְפָרָשִׁ֖ים יַם־ סֽוּף׃

passages.text: So your fathers cried out to the LORD, and He put darkness between you and the Egyptians, over whom He brought the sea and engulfed them. Your very eyes saw what I did to the Egyptians. Then you lived in the wilderness for a long time.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites cried out to the LORD.
The LORD put darkness between the Israelites and the Egyptians.
The LORD brought the sea over the Egyptians.
The LORD covered the Egyptians with the sea.
The Israelites saw with their own eyes what the LORD did to the Egyptians.
The Israelites lived in the wilderness for many days.
passages.original: וַיִּצְעֲק֣וּ אֶל־ יְהוָ֗ה וַיָּ֨שֶׂם מַֽאֲפֵ֜ל בֵּינֵיכֶ֣ם׀ וּבֵ֣ין הַמִּצְרִ֗ים וַיָּבֵ֨א עָלָ֤יו אֶת־ הַיָּם֙ וַיְכַסֵּ֔הוּ וַתִּרְאֶ֙ינָה֙ עֵינֵיכֶ֔ם אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר־ עָשִׂ֖יתִי בְּמִצְרָ֑יִם וַתֵּשְׁב֥וּ בַמִּדְבָּ֖ר יָמִ֥ים רַבִּֽים׃

passages.text: Later, I brought you to the land of the Amorites who lived beyond the Jordan. They fought against you, but I delivered them into your hand, that you should possess their land when I destroyed them before you.
passages.sermon:
God brought the Israelites to the land of the Amorites.
The Amorites lived beyond the Jordan River.
The Amorites fought against the Israelites.
God gave the Amorites into the hands of the Israelites.
The Israelites took possession of the Amorites’ land.
God destroyed the Amorites before the Israelites.
passages.original: וָאָבִאָה אֶתְכֶ֗ם אֶל־ אֶ֤רֶץ הָאֱמֹרִי֙ הַיּוֹשֵׁב֙ בְּעֵ֣בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן וַיִּֽלָּחֲמ֖וּ אִתְּכֶ֑ם וָאֶתֵּ֨ן אוֹתָ֤ם בְּיֶדְכֶם֙ וַתִּֽירְשׁ֣וּ אֶת־ אַרְצָ֔ם וָאַשְׁמִידֵ֖ם מִפְּנֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: Then Balak son of Zippor, the king of Moab, set out to fight against Israel. He sent for Balaam son of Beor to curse you, but I would not listen to Balaam. So he blessed you again and again, and I delivered you from his hand.
passages.sermon:
Balak was the son of Zippor.
Balak was the king of Moab.
Balak set out to fight against Israel.
Balak sent for Balaam.
Balaam was the son of Beor.
Balak wanted Balaam to curse Israel.
I did not listen to Balaam.
Balaam blessed you instead.
I delivered you from Balak’s hand.
passages.original: וַיָּ֨קָם בָּלָ֤ק בֶּן־ צִפּוֹר֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ מוֹאָ֔ב וַיִּלָּ֖חֶם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיִּשְׁלַ֗ח וַיִּקְרָ֛א לְבִלְעָ֥ם בֶּן־ בְּע֖וֹר לְקַלֵּ֥ל אֶתְכֶֽם׃ וְלֹ֥א אָבִ֖יתִי לִשְׁמֹ֣עַ לְבִלְעָ֑ם וַיְבָ֤רֶךְ בָּרוֹךְ֙ אֶתְכֶ֔ם וָאַצִּ֥ל אֶתְכֶ֖ם מִיָּדֽוֹ׃

passages.text: After this, you crossed the Jordan and came to Jericho. The people of Jericho fought against you, as did the Amorites, Perizzites, Canaanites, Hittites, Girgashites, Hivites, and Jebusites, and I delivered them into your hand.
passages.sermon:
God led the people of Israel.
God brought them across the Jordan River.
God brought them to the city of Jericho.
The people of Jericho fought against Israel.
The Amorites fought against Israel.
The Perizzites fought against Israel.
The Canaanites fought against Israel.
The Hittites fought against Israel.
The Girgashites fought against Israel.
The Hivites fought against Israel.
The Jebusites fought against Israel.
God gave all these enemies into Israel’s hand.
passages.original: וַתַּעַבְר֣וּ אֶת־ הַיַּרְדֵּן֮ וַתָּבֹ֣אוּ אֶל־ יְרִיחוֹ֒ וַיִּלָּחֲמ֣וּ בָכֶ֣ם בַּעֲלֵֽי־ יְ֠רִיחוֹ הָֽאֱמֹרִ֨י וְהַפְּרִזִּ֜י וְהַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֗י וְהַֽחִתִּי֙ וְהַגִּרְגָּשִׁ֔י הַֽחִוִּ֖י וְהַיְבוּסִ֑י וָאֶתֵּ֥ן אוֹתָ֖ם בְּיֶדְכֶֽם׃

passages.text: I sent the hornet ahead of you, and it drove out the two Amorite kings before you, but not by your own sword or bow.
passages.sermon:
God acted for Israel.
God sent the hornet ahead of Israel.
The hornet went before Israel.
The hornet drove out the two Amorite kings.
The Amorite kings left because of the hornet.
Israel did not use their own sword.
Israel did not use their own bow.
God, not Israel’s weapons, caused the victory.
passages.original: וָאֶשְׁלַ֤ח לִפְנֵיכֶם֙ אֶת־ הַצִּרְעָ֔ה וַתְּגָ֤רֶשׁ אוֹתָם֙ מִפְּנֵיכֶ֔ם שְׁנֵ֖י מַלְכֵ֣י הָאֱמֹרִ֑י לֹ֥א בְחַרְבְּךָ֖ וְלֹ֥א בְקַשְׁתֶּֽךָ׃

passages.text: So I gave you a land on which you did not toil and cities that you did not build, and now you live in them and eat from vineyards and olive groves that you did not plant.’
passages.sermon:
God gave land to the Israelites.
The Israelites did not work for this land.
God gave cities to the Israelites.
The Israelites did not build these cities.
The Israelites now live in these cities.
God gave vineyards and olive groves to the Israelites.
The Israelites did not plant these vineyards and olive groves.
The Israelites eat from these vineyards and olive groves.
passages.original: וָאֶתֵּ֨ן לָכֶ֜ם אֶ֣רֶץ׀ אֲשֶׁ֧ר לֹֽא־ יָגַ֣עְתָּ בָּ֗הּ וְעָרִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא־ בְנִיתֶ֔ם וַתֵּשְׁב֖וּ בָּהֶ֑ם כְּרָמִ֤ים וְזֵיתִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא־ נְטַעְתֶּ֔ם אַתֶּ֖ם אֹכְלִֽים׃

passages.text: Now, therefore, fear the LORD and serve Him in sincerity and truth; cast aside the gods your fathers served beyond the Euphrates and in Egypt, and serve the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God who brought you and your fathers out of Egypt.
He protected you and did great signs for you.
Now fear the LORD.
Serve the LORD with sincerity.
Serve the LORD with truth.
Remove the gods your fathers served beyond the Euphrates.
Remove the gods your fathers served in Egypt.
Serve the LORD.
passages.original: וְעַתָּ֞ה יְר֧אוּ אֶת־ יְהוָ֛ה וְעִבְד֥וּ אֹת֖וֹ בְּתָמִ֣ים וּבֶֽאֱמֶ֑ת וְהָסִ֣ירוּ אֶת־ אֱלֹהִ֗ים אֲשֶׁר֩ עָבְד֨וּ אֲבוֹתֵיכֶ֜ם בְּעֵ֤בֶר הַנָּהָר֙ וּבְמִצְרַ֔יִם וְעִבְד֖וּ אֶת־ יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: But if it is unpleasing in your sight to serve the LORD, then choose for yourselves this day whom you will serve, whether the gods your fathers served beyond the Euphrates, or the gods of the Amorites in whose land you are living. As for me and my house, we will serve the LORD!”
passages.sermon:
Joshua spoke to the people of Israel.
He was their leader after Moses.
He said, “If you do not want to serve the LORD, decide today whom you will serve.
You can choose the gods your ancestors served beyond the Euphrates River.
You can choose the gods of the Amorites, in whose land you now live.
But I and my family will serve the LORD.”
passages.original: וְאִם֩ רַ֨ע בְּֽעֵינֵיכֶ֜ם לַעֲבֹ֣ד אֶת־ יְהוָ֗ה בַּחֲר֨וּ לָכֶ֣ם הַיּוֹם֮ אֶת־ מִ֣י תַעֲבֹדוּן֒ אִ֣ם אֶת־ אֱלֹהִ֞ים אֲשֶׁר־ עָבְד֣וּ אֲבוֹתֵיכֶ֗ם אֲשֶׁר֙ בְּעֵבֶר הַנָּהָ֔ר וְאִם֙ אֶת־ אֱלֹהֵ֣י הָאֱמֹרִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתֶּ֖ם יֹשְׁבִ֣ים בְּאַרְצָ֑ם וְאָנֹכִ֣י וּבֵיתִ֔י נַעֲבֹ֖ד אֶת־ יְהוָֽה׃פ

passages.text: The people replied, “Far be it from us to forsake the LORD to serve other gods!
passages.sermon:
The people answered Joshua.
They spoke together.
They said, “We will not leave the LORD.
We will not serve other gods.
We refuse to abandon the LORD for any other god.”
passages.original: וַיַּ֤עַן הָעָם֙ וַיֹּ֔אמֶר חָלִ֣ילָה לָּ֔נוּ מֵעֲזֹ֖ב אֶת־ יְהוָ֑ה לַעֲבֹ֖ד אֱלֹהִ֥ים אֲחֵרִֽים׃

passages.text: For the LORD our God brought us and our fathers out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery, and performed these great signs before our eyes. He also protected us throughout our journey and among all the nations through which we traveled.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is our God.
The LORD brought us out of Egypt.
The LORD brought our fathers out of Egypt.
Egypt was a land of slavery.
The LORD took us out of the house of slavery.
The LORD did great signs before our eyes.
The LORD protected us on every part of our journey.
The LORD kept us safe among all the nations we passed through.
passages.original: כִּ֚י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֔ינוּ הוּא֩ הַמַּעֲלֶ֨ה אֹתָ֧נוּ וְאֶת־ אֲבוֹתֵ֛ינוּ מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם מִבֵּ֣ית עֲבָדִ֑ים וַאֲשֶׁ֧ר עָשָׂ֣ה לְעֵינֵ֗ינוּ אֶת־ הָאֹת֤וֹת הַגְּדֹלוֹת֙ הָאֵ֔לֶּה וַֽיִּשְׁמְרֵ֗נוּ בְּכָל־ הַדֶּ֙רֶךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָלַ֣כְנוּ בָ֔הּ וּבְכֹל֙ הָֽעַמִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָבַ֖רְנוּ בְּקִרְבָּֽם׃

passages.text: And the LORD drove out before us all the nations, including the Amorites who lived in the land. We too will serve the LORD, because He is our God!”
passages.sermon:
The LORD is our God.
The LORD drove out all the nations before us.
The LORD drove out the Amorites who lived in the land.
We will also serve the LORD.
He is our God.
passages.original: וַיְגָ֨רֶשׁ יְהוָ֜ה אֶת־ כָּל־ הָעַמִּ֗ים וְאֶת־ הָאֱמֹרִ֛י יֹשֵׁ֥ב הָאָ֖רֶץ מִפָּנֵ֑ינוּ גַּם־ אֲנַ֙חְנוּ֙ נַעֲבֹ֣ד אֶת־ יְהוָ֔ה כִּי־ ה֖וּא אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃ס

passages.text: But Joshua said to the people, “You are not able to serve the LORD, for He is a holy God; He is a jealous God; He will not forgive your rebellion or your sins.
passages.sermon:
Joshua spoke to the people.
He said, "You cannot serve the LORD.
The LORD is our God.
He is holy.
He is a jealous God.
He will not forgive your rebellion.
He will not forgive your sins."
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁ֜עַ אֶל־ הָעָ֗ם לֹ֤א תֽוּכְלוּ֙ לַעֲבֹ֣ד אֶת־ יְהוָ֔ה כִּֽי־ אֱלֹהִ֥ים קְדֹשִׁ֖ים ה֑וּא אֵֽל־ קַנּ֣וֹא ה֔וּא לֹֽא־ יִשָּׂ֥א לְפִשְׁעֲכֶ֖ם וּלְחַטֹּאותֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: If you forsake the LORD and serve foreign gods, He will turn and bring disaster on you and consume you, even after He has been good to you.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
He has been good to you.
If you leave the LORD,
and if you serve foreign gods,
then the LORD will turn against you.
He will bring disaster on you.
He will destroy you.
He will do this even after He has done good for you.
passages.original: כִּ֤י תַֽעַזְבוּ֙ אֶת־ יְהוָ֔ה וַעֲבַדְתֶּ֖ם אֱלֹהֵ֣י נֵכָ֑ר וְשָׁ֨ב וְהֵרַ֤ע לָכֶם֙ וְכִלָּ֣ה אֶתְכֶ֔ם אַחֲרֵ֖י אֲשֶׁר־ הֵיטִ֥יב לָכֶֽם׃

passages.text: “No!” replied the people. “We will serve the LORD!”
passages.sermon: The people spoke to Joshua.\r\nThey said, “No.”\r\nThey said, “We will serve the LORD.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר הָעָ֖ם אֶל־ יְהוֹשֻׁ֑עַ לֹ֕א כִּ֥י אֶת־ יְהוָ֖ה נַעֲבֹֽד׃

passages.text: Then Joshua told them, “You are witnesses against yourselves that you have chosen to serve the LORD.” “We are witnesses!” they said.
passages.sermon:
Joshua spoke to the people of Israel.
He said, "You are witnesses against yourselves."
You have chosen the LORD.
You have chosen to serve Him.
The people answered Joshua.
They said, "We are witnesses."
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁ֜עַ אֶל־ הָעָ֗ם עֵדִ֤ים אַתֶּם֙ בָּכֶ֔ם כִּֽי־ אַתֶּ֞ם בְּחַרְתֶּ֥ם לָכֶ֛ם אֶת־ יְהוָ֖ה לַעֲבֹ֣ד אוֹת֑וֹ וַיֹּאמְר֖וּ עֵדִֽים׃

passages.text: “Now, therefore,” he said, “get rid of the foreign gods among you and incline your hearts to the LORD, the God of Israel.”
passages.sermon:
Joshua spoke to the people of Israel.
Joshua told them what to do.
He said, “Remove the foreign gods that are among you.
Turn your hearts to the LORD.
The LORD is the God of Israel.”
passages.original: וְעַתָּ֕ה הָסִ֛ירוּ אֶת־ אֱלֹהֵ֥י הַנֵּכָ֖ר אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּקִרְבְּכֶ֑ם וְהַטּוּ֙ אֶת־ לְבַבְכֶ֔ם אֶל־ יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: So the people said to Joshua, “We will serve the LORD our God and obey His voice.”
passages.sermon: The people spoke to Joshua.\r\nThey said, “We will serve the LORD our God.\r\nWe will obey His voice.”
passages.original: וַיֹּאמְר֥וּ הָעָ֖ם אֶל־ יְהוֹשֻׁ֑עַ אֶת־ יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵ֙ינוּ֙ נַעֲבֹ֔ד וּבְקוֹל֖וֹ נִשְׁמָֽע׃

passages.text: On that day Joshua made a covenant for the people, and there at Shechem he established for them a statute and ordinance.
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel.
On that day, Joshua made a covenant for the people.
He did this at Shechem.
Joshua established a statute there.
He also established an ordinance there.
passages.original: וַיִּכְרֹ֨ת יְהוֹשֻׁ֧עַ בְּרִ֛ית לָעָ֖ם בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֑וּא וַיָּ֥שֶׂם ל֛וֹ חֹ֥ק וּמִשְׁפָּ֖ט בִּשְׁכֶֽם׃

passages.text: Joshua recorded these things in the Book of the Law of God. Then he took a large stone and set it up there under the oak that was near the sanctuary of the LORD.
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel.
Joshua wrote these things in the Book of the Law of God.
Joshua took a large stone.
Joshua set the stone up there.
He placed it under the oak tree.
The oak tree was near the sanctuary of the LORD.
passages.original: וַיִּכְתֹּ֤ב יְהוֹשֻׁ֙עַ֙ אֶת־ הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה בְּסֵ֖פֶר תּוֹרַ֣ת אֱלֹהִ֑ים וַיִּקַּח֙ אֶ֣בֶן גְּדוֹלָ֔ה וַיְקִימֶ֣הָ שָּׁ֔ם תַּ֚חַת הָֽאַלָּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּמִקְדַּ֥שׁ יְהוָֽה׃ס

passages.text: And Joshua said to all the people, “You see this stone. It will be a witness against us, for it has heard all the words the LORD has spoken to us, and it will be a witness against you if you ever deny your God.”
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel.
\r\nHe spoke to all the people.
\r\nHe said, “Look at this stone.
\r\nThis stone will be a witness against us.
\r\nThe stone has heard every word the LORD spoke to us.
\r\nThe stone will stand as a witness against you.
\r\nIt will remind you not to deny your God.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁ֜עַ אֶל־ כָּל־ הָעָ֗ם הִנֵּ֨ה הָאֶ֤בֶן הַזֹּאת֙ תִּֽהְיֶה־ בָּ֣נוּ לְעֵדָ֔ה כִּֽי־ הִ֣יא שָׁמְעָ֗ה אֵ֚ת כָּל־ אִמְרֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֶּ֖ר עִמָּ֑נוּ וְהָיְתָ֤ה בָכֶם֙ לְעֵדָ֔ה פֶּֽן־ תְּכַחֲשׁ֖וּן בֵּאלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: Then Joshua sent the people away, each to his own inheritance.
passages.sermon: Joshua was the leader of Israel.\r\nJoshua sent the people away.\r\nEach person went to his own inheritance.
passages.original: וַיְשַׁלַּ֤ח יְהוֹשֻׁ֙עַ֙ אֶת־ הָעָ֔ם אִ֖ישׁ לְנַחֲלָתֽוֹ׃פ

passages.text: Some time later, Joshua son of Nun, the servant of the LORD, died at the age of 110.
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the son of Nun.
Joshua served the LORD.
Joshua died.
He was 110 years old when he died.
This happened some time after these events.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֗י אַֽחֲרֵי֙ הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה וַיָּ֛מָת יְהוֹשֻׁ֥עַ בִּן־ נ֖וּן עֶ֣בֶד יְהוָ֑ה בֶּן־ מֵאָ֥ה וָעֶ֖שֶׂר שָׁנִֽים׃

passages.text: And they buried him in the land of his inheritance, at Timnath-serah in the hill country of Ephraim, north of Mount Gaash.
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the son of Nun.
Joshua served the LORD.
Joshua died at the age of 110.
The people buried Joshua.
They buried him in the land that he inherited.
They buried him at Timnath-serah.
Timnath-serah is in the hill country of Ephraim.
Timnath-serah is north of Mount Gaash.
passages.original: וַיִּקְבְּר֤וּ אֹתוֹ֙ בִּגְב֣וּל נַחֲלָת֔וֹ בְּתִמְנַת־ סֶ֖רַח אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּהַר־ אֶפְרָ֑יִם מִצְּפ֖וֹן לְהַר־ גָּֽעַשׁ׃

passages.text: Israel had served the LORD throughout the days of Joshua and of the elders who outlived him and who had experienced all the works that the LORD had done for Israel.
passages.sermon:
Israel served the LORD.
Joshua led Israel.
Joshua was the son of Nun.
Joshua was the servant of the LORD.
Israel served the LORD all the days of Joshua.
Elders lived after Joshua died.
These elders lived a long time after Joshua.
These elders knew all the works of the LORD.
The LORD had done many works for Israel.
Israel served the LORD all the days of these elders.
passages.original: וַיַּעֲבֹ֤ד יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶת־ יְהוָ֔ה כֹּ֖ל יְמֵ֣י יְהוֹשֻׁ֑עַ וְכֹ֣ל׀ יְמֵ֣י הַזְּקֵנִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֶאֱרִ֤יכוּ יָמִים֙ אַחֲרֵ֣י יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ וַאֲשֶׁ֣ר יָדְע֗וּ אֵ֚ת כָּל־ מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֖ה לְיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: And the bones of Joseph, which the Israelites had brought up out of Egypt, were buried at Shechem in the plot of land that Jacob had purchased from the sons of Hamor, Shechem’s father, for a hundred pieces of silver. So it became an inheritance for Joseph’s descendants.
passages.sermon:
Joseph was a leader of Israel.
The Israelites brought Joseph’s bones out of Egypt.
They buried Joseph’s bones at Shechem.
Jacob was Joseph’s father.
Jacob had bought a field at Shechem.
Jacob bought this field from the sons of Hamor.
Hamor was the father of Shechem.
Jacob paid one hundred pieces of silver for the field.
This field became the inheritance of Joseph’s descendants.
passages.original: וְאֶת־ עַצְמ֣וֹת י֠וֹסֵף אֲשֶׁר־ הֶעֱל֨וּ בְנֵי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל׀ מִמִּצְרַיִם֮ קָבְר֣וּ בִשְׁכֶם֒ בְּחֶלְקַ֣ת הַשָּׂדֶ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר קָנָ֧ה יַעֲקֹ֛ב מֵאֵ֛ת בְּנֵֽי־ חֲמ֥וֹר אֲבִֽי־ שְׁכֶ֖ם בְּמֵאָ֣ה קְשִׂיטָ֑ה וַיִּֽהְי֥וּ לִבְנֵֽי־ יוֹסֵ֖ף לְנַחֲלָֽה׃

passages.text: Eleazar son of Aaron also died, and they buried him at Gibeah, which had been given to his son Phinehas in the hill country of Ephraim.
passages.sermon:
Eleazar was the son of Aaron.
Eleazar died.
They buried Eleazar at Gibeah.
Gibeah had been given to Phinehas.
Phinehas was Eleazar’s son.
Gibeah was in the hill country of Ephraim.
passages.original: וְאֶלְעָזָ֥ר בֶּֽן־ אַהֲרֹ֖ן מֵ֑ת וַיִּקְבְּר֣וּ אֹת֗וֹ בְּגִבְעַת֙ פִּֽינְחָ֣ס בְּנ֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִתַּן־ ל֖וֹ בְּהַ֥ר אֶפְרָֽיִם׃
